query:
SELECT timestamp
              FROM meteora_damm_v2_swap_events
             WHERE timestamp >= $1
               AND timestamp <= COALESCE($2, 'infinity'::TIMESTAMPTZ)
               AND (timestamp < COALESCE($2, 'infinity'::TIMESTAMPTZ)
                    OR (signature, event_index) < ($3, $4))
             ORDER BY timestamp DESC
             OFFSET $5::BIGINT - 1
             LIMIT 1
